ats_tips: Use simple fonts: Times New Roman, Calibri, Arial
No tables, graphics, or columns — ATS can't read them
Use keywords: Java, Python, Git, DSA
File format: PDF always
common_mistakes: Including hobbies like cricket, music — irrelevant to SDE
example_summary: First-year B.Tech (CSE) student building programming fundamentals. Proficient in Java and Python. Active GitHub profile with 3+ projects.
linkedin_sync_note: Keep skills section consistent with LinkedIn profile

ats_tips: Quantify projects: 'Built REST API handling 500 req/sec'
Add GitHub repo links to each project
Skills section: Programming Languages, Frameworks, Databases, Tools
Action verbs: Designed, Developed, Implemented, Optimized
common_mistakes: No project descriptions — just project names
CGPA below 6.0 prominently displayed — put it but don't highlight
No mention of tech stack used in each project
example_summary: 2nd-year B.Tech CSE student. Proficient in Java, Spring Boot, MySQL. Built 3 backend projects. 120+ LeetCode problems solved.
resume_checklist: GitHub link present and profile is populated
All projects have: description, tech stack, GitHub link

ats_tips: Include Blinkit-relevant keywords: Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Redis, DSA, System Design
Quantify everything: 'Reduced API latency by 30% using Redis caching'
Use job description keywords
Projects should show scale: 'Handled 1000 concurrent users'
common_mistakes: Weak project descriptions like 'Made a website'
